messages.subject: Stratton – our position on the DL mark-up
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Elena,

Denham Lewis have come back on the Stratton MSA. Proposed lines for us to take with Caspian:
- Liability cap: they want 200%, we drafted 100%. Suggest we offer 150% with the usual uncapped carve-outs (confidentiality, IP, data protection).
- Uptime: they want 99.9%, we have 99.5%. 99.8% is comfortable for the platform – recommend that.
- Hosting: UK-only is a problem because two of our sub-processors are in the EEA. Offer UK hosting but EEA sub-processors permitted with safeguards.
- Payment: split the difference at 45 days.
- Termination for convenience: resist any time; offer post-Initial-Term only on 180 days.

Views before I update the client?

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
